title: Conference papers are cooked! [D]
summary: Got three papers to review for ICLR and five for AAMAS, and believe me the quality of these papers is insanely bad. I would even refrain from accepting them to a workshop, let alone be main venues. A sincere request; Please don't submit the paper unless it is ready and if you are
reason: Reddit discussion post venting about poor-quality conference submissions for ICLR/AAMAS. No new research artifact, paper link, model release, business event, policy action, or OSS tool, so no active rule covers it.
